description: This file defines the GatewayDiscoveryModel class responsible for discovering, managing, and resolving network gateways using Bonjour (mDNS) and other fallback mechanisms. It includes data structures for representing identities and gateways, methods for starting/stopping discovery, handling resolution of network services, and utility functions for parsing TXT records and normalizing hostnames.

classes.name: GatewayDiscoveryModel
classes.description: Main class managing network gateway discovery, maintaining browser instances, resolving services, and aggregating gateway information.

classes.name: ResolvedGatewayService
classes.description: Data structure representing resolved network service details including TXT records, host, and port.

classes.name: GatewayServiceResolver
classes.description: NetService delegate class that resolves network services asynchronously and calls back with resolution results.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes network discovery by creating browsers for configured service domains and scheduling fallback tasks.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops all ongoing discovery processes, cancels tasks, and clears cached data.

methods.name: refreshRemoteFallbackNow
methods.description: Triggers immediate refresh of fallback gateways from wide-area and Tailscale sources.

methods.name: mapWideAreaBeacons
methods.description: Maps wide-area beacon data to DiscoveredGateway objects.

methods.name: mapTailscaleServeBeacons
methods.description: Maps Tailscale Serve beacons to DiscoveredGateway objects.

methods.name: updateGateways
methods.description: Updates internal list of gateways based on current results for a specific domain.

methods.name: ensureServiceResolution
methods.description: Initiates DNS service resolution for a given service, ensuring only one resolver per service.

methods.name: parseGatewayTXT
methods.description: Parses TXT record dictionary into GatewayTXT structure with specific fields.

methods.name: buildSSHTarget
methods.description: Constructs an SSH target string from username, host, and port.

methods.name: isLocalGateway
methods.description: Determines if a gateway is local based on hostname and identity tokens.
